facts.business: Sigachi Industries Limited is a global pharmaceutical excipient manufacturer serving over 500 customers across 65 countries with products used in pharmaceutical, food, nutrition, and healthcare industries.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: will add 12,000 MTPA of Microcrystalline Cellulose capacity, taking total manufacturing capacity to 30,000 MTPA

auditor.name: Yelamanchi & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Assessment of loss due to fire incident at Hyderabad unit production facility resulting in losses of Rs 118.21 crores relating to fixed assets, inventories, compensation, medical expenses and ITC reversal; insurance claims to be recognized upon receipt.

key_risks: Fire incident at Hyderabad manufacturing facility causing significant damage to property, plant and equipment, inventories and disruption to operations
Significant management judgment in determination of carrying value of assets damaged, measurement of losses, estimation of recoverable amounts from insurers, and presentation of financial impact
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during FY 2025-26 were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions with Promoters, Directors, KMP or other designated persons which may have potential conflict with interest of Company. Omnibus approval obtained from Audit Committee. Form AOC-2 attached as Annexure-III.
